title: zornia adenophora
intro: Zornia adenophora, commonly known as the Mexican clammy clover, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, respiratory problems, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits in lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in weight loss. The therapeutic actions of Zornia adenophora are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Zornia adenophora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic uses.
